metadata.question: During the year of 2018, did Washington D.C. experience at least 50 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in Washington D.C. during 2018, specifically if there was at least 50 inches of rainfall. For rainfall data, I should use: - Collection: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) - daily precipitation data - Time: 2018-01-01 to 2018-12-31 - Location: Washington D.C. area Strategy: 1. Define a polygon around Washington D.C. 2. Get CHIRPS daily precipitation data for 2018 3. Check if collection has data 4. Sum all daily precipitation to get annual total 5. Convert from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) 6. Check if annual rainfall >= 50 inches I need to handle: - C1: If no CHIRPS data for 2018 in that location - C2: If all pixels are masked/out of bounds - C3: If calculation returns invalid result - A/B: Based on whether rainfall >= 50 inches For Washington D.C., I'll create a polygon around the area. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const dcGeometry = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-77.1198, 38.7916], [-77.0328, 38.7916], [-77.0328, 38.9956], [-77.1198, 38.9956], [-77.1198, 38.7916] ]); const startDate = '2018-01-01'; const endDate = '2018-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS Daily Precipitation const chirpsCollection = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(dcGeometry); const collectionSize = chirpsCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018 CHIRPS Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No precipitation data found for 2018."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate annual precipitation sum const annualPrecip = chirpsCollection.sum(); // 4. Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = annualPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: dcGeometry, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels in region: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid precipitation pixels in region."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Calculate mean annual precipitation (mm) const meanAnnualPrecip = annualPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: dcGeometry, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); // Convert mm to inches const annualRainfallInches = meanAnnualPrecip / 25.4; console.log(`Annual rainfall: ${annualRainfallInches.toFixed(2)} inches`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (meanAnnualPrecip === null || isNaN(meanAnnualPrecip) || annualRainfallInches < 0 || annualRainfallInches > 200) { console.log("Invalid precipitation calculation result."); console.log("C3"); } else if (annualRainfallInches >= 50) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
